description: Stage 3C frozen settings, chosen on the dev set only (healthcare + retail). Part B runs the held-out SaaS set once with exactly these settings; anything changed after seeing SaaS results is reported separately as post-hoc.

doc_rag.description: Ungated baseline, unchanged from Stage 3B: always the top-k glossary chunks.

doc_rag_gated.description: Send a definition only if its term or one of its listed aliases appears in the question; no definitions means the prompt is identical to zero_shot.
doc_rag_gated.matching: whole-word phrase, case-insensitive, hyphens as spaces, plural -s ignored, FY<year> matches FY; a match inside a longer match for another chunk is dropped
doc_rag_gated.retrieval_fallback_reason: Term matching found every required chunk on all 60 dev glossary questions and gave no definitions to any of the 120 original questions, so no fallback was added.

oracle_doc: exactly the question's required_chunks, in the order listed
glossaries: docs/glossary/{healthcare,retail,saas}.md as committed with this file (aliases included)
